{{Forever only|ability}} {{#data:infobox ability |name=Comprehend Scroll |icon=comprehendscroll_8188276 |description=Decipher an untranslated scroll. |class=Mage |cast_time=Instant |school=Physical |level=6 }} '''Comprehend Scroll''' is a [[mage]] ability used to translate undeciphered scrolls into usable items. The mage's Comprehension skill starts at 1, and is increased by 1 for every scroll successfully deciphered. This is the {{g|forever}} version of [[Comprehension Charm]] items from {{g|sod}}. It is possible for this spell to backfire, [[polymorph]]ing the mage into a sheep for 8 seconds. The scroll is not consumed if this occurs. ==List of scrolls== {| class="darktable zebra" |+ Enciphered scrolls |- ! Required Skill !! Scrolls !!
